title: 009 神庙010 封印松动
content_zh:
烂尾楼内，那道幽魂般的身影缓缓自墙面浮现而出，由虚幻的灵体状态逐渐变得清晰。
它如同一片深嵌在墙中的人形暗影，五官的轮廓在阴影中凸显，好似从墙面延伸生长出来的一般，凝聚的嘴巴微微开合：
“第一步计划就失败了。
那件从岳山庙流窜出的邪异物还没成长起来，就已经被神异司盯上。
这几天差点就被锁定位置，要不是我出手干预，现在它已经被关押。”
“怎么会这样？”
一个面庞僵硬发青、声音沙哑的老者缓缓开口，语调沉重，“明明安排好了从最底层的普通人下手，而且是在东区，神异司不该第一时间派出高手。
等他们察觉时，感染范围早就已经扩散，邪异物也该顺利成长起来才对。”
墙上的影子轮廓沉声道：
“计划不如变化快。
东区神异司有个人道序列九的【亭长】队长，已经带着几个队员在追踪邪异物的线索……其他尸体上的诅咒，也都被控制住了。
他们似乎很快就发现了邪异物传播的诅咒气息，非常机敏，完全是出乎意料。”
“这么快就能发觉并处理诅咒气息，的确不正常。”
坐在大门处的妇女讶然出声，随即皱眉，“邪异物还没成长起来就被盯上，我们的计划还怎么进行？”
墙上阴影微微晃动，语气转冷：
“不如将计就计。
引他们对付邪异物的时候，我们再暗中出手，把他们全都解决，喂养给邪异物。
这样它就能快速成长，之后自会和青龙寺的神庙内的部件组合，而后返回城外的古宅，为我们打开封印。”
“恐怕不行。”
墙角的一口缸内竟传出了一个孩童的声音反驳：

“这样一来，就算得手，也会惊动神异司。
即便打开了古宅封印，我们也很难全身而退。”
“我们的命早已献给了救世会。”
墙上的阴影声音坚决，“现在情况越拖越不利于我们，只要能完成计划，牺牲……也是值得。”
屋内一时陷入寂静，仿佛都在权衡这个抉择。
...
时间一晃，很快便是几天过去。
通过持续阅览神异司内部网的讯息。
许临东对“超凡天坑入侵”
这个笼罩现实世界的宏大事件，已经有了相当深入的了解。
天坑也分为低危、中危、高危以及禁区四种。
其中禁区天坑，诸如国内像泰山的“酆都鬼门”
天坑，曾经开启时就涌出过大量诡异的阴兵，但也曾伴随一些地道序列的超凡宝物出世。
还有“神农山”
以及‘蚩尤冢’天坑，前者曾经喷发出了超凡灵脉，后者则绽放宝光，引得各方势力争夺，但不少强者都失踪在了里面。
国外如“百慕大海漩”
，曾扭曲八方海域的环境，吞噬船舰，甚至曾冒出了沉入海底许久的‘幽灵泰坦号’。
这些天坑的波动，往往会牵连现实。
一些本就神秘的地区，如一直传闻有野人活动的神农山，超凡复苏后会变得更恐怖。
不过对于现在的他而言，只需要重点关注和探索低危天坑即可。
content_en:
In the unfinished building, the ghostly figure slowly emerged from the wall, gradually becoming clear from the illusory spiritual state.
It is like a human-shaped shadow embedded deeply in the wall. The outline of the facial features is highlighted in the shadow, as if it is extending and growing from the wall. The condensed mouth opens and closes slightly:
“The plan failed on the first step.
The evil foreign object that escaped from the Yueshan Temple had not yet grown up, but it was already being targeted by the Department of Mysteries.
It was almost locked in place in the past few days, and if I hadn't intervened, it would have been imprisoned now. "
"How could this happen?"
An old man with a stiff and blue face and a hoarse voice spoke slowly, with a heavy tone, "It is obviously arranged to start with ordinary people at the lowest level, and it is in the East District. The Department of Mysteries should not send out experts immediately.
By the time they noticed it, the infection had already spread, and the evil foreign body should have grown up smoothly. "
The shadow silhouette on the wall said solemnly:
“Plans don’t change as fast as they do.
There is a captain of the Humanity Sequence 9 [Pavilion Chief] from the East District Mystery Department, who has led several team members to track down clues about evil objects... The curses on other corpses have also been controlled.
They seemed to have quickly discovered the cursed aura spread by the evil foreign body. They were very alert and completely unexpected. "
"It is indeed abnormal to be able to detect and deal with the cursed aura so quickly."
The woman sitting at the gate made a sound in surprise, then frowned, "How can our plan proceed if the evil alien object is targeted before it even grows up?"
The shadow on the wall shook slightly, and his tone turned cold:
"It's better to use the trick.
When we lead them to deal with the evil alien objects, we will secretly take action to kill them all and feed them to the evil alien objects.
In this way, it can grow quickly, and then it will be combined with the parts in the temple of Qinglong Temple, and then return to the ancient house outside the city to open the seal for us. "
"I'm afraid not."
A child's voice retorted from a vat in the corner:
“In this way, even if we succeed, it will alarm the Department of Mysteries.
Even if the seal of the ancient house is opened, it will be difficult for us to escape intact. "
"Our lives have long been dedicated to the Salvation Society."
The shadow voice on the wall said firmly, "The situation is getting worse and worse for us now. As long as we can complete the plan, the sacrifice... is worth it."
The room fell silent for a moment, as if everyone was weighing this choice.
...
Time flies, and a few days pass quickly.
By continuing to read the information on the intranet of the Department of Mysteries.
Xu Lindong’s response to the “Extraordinary Tiankeng Invasion”
This grand event that envelopes the real world has already been understood quite deeply.
Sinkholes are also divided into four types: low risk, medium risk, high risk and restricted area.
Among them, there are forbidden tiankeng, such as the "Fengdu Ghost Gate" in China, which is like Mount Tai.
When the Tiankeng was opened, a large number of strange Yin soldiers emerged, but it was also accompanied by the emergence of some extraordinary treasures in the underground sequence.
And "Shennong Mountain"
As well as the 'Chi You Tomb' sinkhole, the former once erupted with extraordinary spiritual veins, while the latter bloomed with precious light, attracting various forces to compete, but many powerful people have disappeared inside.
Abroad such as "Bermuda Whirlpool"
, once distorted the environment of the sea areas in all directions, devoured ships, and even emerged the "Ghost Titan" that had sunk to the bottom of the sea for a long time.
The fluctuations in these sinkholes often involve reality.
Some already mysterious areas, such as Shennong Mountain, where there have been rumors of savage activities, will become even more terrifying after their supernatural resurrection.
But for now, he only needs to focus on and explore low-risk sinkholes.
